plugins.name: venture-blueprint
plugins.description: Plans a software product or company from a rough idea, or none: brainstorms two or three paths with their own numbers and app screens, then a full business plan with personas, competitors, projections, every department and validation experiments, shown as an interactive venture site with a clickable prototype; then, when asked, a build roadmap.
